description: github: Contributions. GET /v1/github/user/contributions. Provide one of: handle, url. Get a user's GitHub contribution graph for a year. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

year.description: Contribution graph year. Defaults to the current year.
